body_lead: The Tamil Nadu government on Tuesday announced a comprehensive suite of initiatives under the Department of Artificial Intelligence, Information Technology, and Digital Services to position the state as a 'national leader' in AI and deep-tech innovation. Presented in the State Legislative Assembly by Minister Kumar R, the new announcements encompass multi-crore funds, state-of-the-art infrastructure, public-private partnerships, and specialised AI tools across multiple sectors.
